core_meaning.primary_meaning: Muhammad is an Arabic-origin name meaning “The praised one”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Muhammad corresponds to the Arabic form محمد (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad)). Its core sense is muhammad; the praised one. Muhammad is Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad) 'the praised one', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); it is the name of the Prophet of Islam. etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

origin.origin_explanation: The name originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming through established multilingual use.

religion.religious_status: Culturally used; not inherently a doctrinal term
religion.religious_explanation: Muhammad is used by Muslims as a personal name, but the word itself is lexical in origin; its Islamic association is cultural rather than scriptural.

quranic_status.note: Muhammad is a Qur'anic name: it is the name of the Prophet of Islam, mentioned in the Qur'an.

islamic_naming_context.context: Muslim naming culture in South Asia and the Persianate world
islamic_naming_context.interpretation: Its lexical sense is a positive quality that families may wish for a child.
islamic_naming_context.important_distinction: Muslim use of the name is not evidence that the word is Qur'anic or religiously prescribed.

cultural_context.cultural_meaning: In the communities that use it, the name reads as a positive quality.
cultural_context.personal_name_interpretation: As a personal name it can be read as a wish for the quality it names.
cultural_context.interpretation_warning: The symbolic reading is a cultural convention, distinct from the dictionary sense.

spiritual_meaning.meaning: Families may read the sense “The praised one” as a hopeful quality for the child.

urdu.name: محمد
urdu.long_meaning: Muhammad (محمد) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم محمد، بہت تعریف کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: محمد
persian.long_meaning: Muhammad (محمد) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن محمد، بسیار ستوده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मुहम्मद
hindi.long_meaning: Muhammad (मुहम्मद) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ मुहम्मद, अत्यंत प्रशंसित है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: محمد
pashto.long_meaning: Muhammad (محمد) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې محمد، ډېر ستایل شوی ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: محمد
arabic.long_meaning: Muhammad (محمد) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي مُحَمَّد، الْكَثِير الْحَمْد. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.q: What is the origin of Muhammad?
faq.a: Muhammad originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
Yes, the recorded form محمد is Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Muhammad?
faq.a: It is built on the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d).
Muhammad is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Yes, Muhammad is a Qur'anic name (see the religion section).

faq.q: What does Muhammad mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written محمد and carries the sense “محمد، بہت تعریف کیا گیا”.

faq.q: Is Muhammad a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Muhammad as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
